intent: The partner account types and the listing module (ADR 0033 D7 and D8): choosing Hotel or wedding hall versus Service provider, creating and editing a listing with a standard and a voucher price, choosing a weekly, monthly or annual advertising plan (rates TBD, major hotels exempt), paying, and following the manual review through pending, approved or rejected with reasons. Listings are never published on payment; a moderator approves each one. Also listing performance. Service providers use the same Partner app shell with Listings in the slot of Calendar.

screens.purpose: First-run application of a service provider or a private hall (PA-ACC-07, ADR 0038): choose the account type (Service provider or Private hall; a hotel or hall chain is onboarded by Ghazal as before), then send the form with the business information. Submit shows 'Application received' and the account stays under review (HL-ACCS-04); Ghazal staff accept or reject it in the Super Admin web, and only an accepted account can create listings. A rejected application comes back here through 'Edit and resubmit', prefilled, with the reason on top.
interactions: Two large choice cards, each with an icon and a title: 'Service provider' and 'Private hall'; one choice, then 'Continue'. A quiet line says that hotels and hall chains join through Ghazal (no form for them)

The form (OQ-R2-03): business name in Arabic and English (both required, completeness markers), categories for a provider (up to three from the registered list in a sheet, the five primary first) plus the open 'Other category' note for a service that is not in the list (a provider needs a category or the note; staff add the category or reject, PA-ACC-08), governorate as wrapping single-choice chips from the governorates reference data, contact person, phone with the +965 chip, email, short description (240 characters), optional commercial licence reference. A private hall has no categories

'Send application' validates (inline errors plus one line 'Complete the marked fields'), shows a short submitting state, then 'Application received': 'Your account stays under review', the business as a quiet row and three glyph rows for what happens next (Ghazal reviews, we email you, then add listings); the one action opens the account status (HL-ACCS-04)
Error: the form stays with its values and a note 'Nothing was sent. Try again.' with Retry; offline disables the action with the reason
Edit and resubmit (from HL-ACCS-04, rejected): the same form prefilled, top bar 'Edit application', the staff reason in a note on top; submitting again returns to 'Application received'
screens.contentNotes: Cards AR / EN: «مقدّم خدمة» / 'Service provider'; «قاعة خاصة» / 'Private hall'. Category labels from CL-SERV-01. Demo provider: Zahra Floral Studio (fixture, Hawalli, Floral arrangements, contact Zahra Al-Mutairi, zahra@zahra-floral.example); demo hall: Taima Grand Palace (fixture, Jahra). Governorate names come from the reference data, never typed. Fee exemption is never chosen here (Ghazal sets it). The form has no logo upload (the logo is edited in the account profile, PA-ACC-03). Not a Client app form: the Client app only shows the one-line note of CA-SVC-20.

ownerRound2.change: HL-PROV-01 becomes the partner application form (PA-ACC-07, PA-ACC-08)
ownerRound2.note: Working assumption OQ-R2-03 for the fields; the Ghazal staff decision is a prototype switch (HL-ACCS-04 tray in the live player).

screens.purpose: The provider's home for listings (the slot of the Calendar tab for service providers; More for hotels that also list services): every listing with its lifecycle status, plan period and a clear next action. Create a listing from here.
interactions: Cards by status chip (Draft, Waiting for payment, In review, Approved, Rejected, Live, Expired, Paused) with category, title in the UI language, plan and "until" date, and the next action ("Choose a plan", "Fix and resubmit", "Renew")
Primary "New listing" opens the editor (HL-PROV-03); tapping a card opens the editor or the review status (HL-PROV-06) by state; Live cards link to performance (HL-PROV-07)
A banner shows plan expiry at -7 days; for major hotels the banner reads "No listing fees" and the payment steps are absent
screens.contentNotes: Demo (illustrative): «تنسيق ورد الأفراح» Floral arrangements, Live until Fri 11 Dec 2026; «بوفيه الضيافة الذهبي» Buffet services, In review; a draft. Chips AR: «مسودة» «بانتظار الدفع» «قيد المراجعة» «معتمد» «مرفوض» «منشور» «منتهي» «متوقف».

screens.purpose: Create or edit a listing: category, bilingual title and description, photos, and packages each with a standard price and a voucher price on the same basis (per person or package). Saves as a draft; "Continue" chooses the plan. Editing a live listing returns it to review while the approved version stays live (A-09).
interactions: Category picker (five primary first, then more); title and description in Arabic and English with completeness markers (both required before submitting); photos from the shared uploader (empty rooms, plates, arrangements, no faces)

Packages: name, inclusions, pricing structure (Per person or Package), Standard price and Voucher price (voucher at or below standard; a saving below the KD 2 fee shows the line "Clients will not be offered a voucher for this package"); live preview "What couples see"
Contact options for the browse-only path (chat on, phone shown or hidden); "Save draft" and the primary "Continue" (opens the plan chooser, or submits straight to review for a fee-exempt partner)
Leaving with edits opens the guard "Discard changes?"; editing a live listing shows "Your approved version stays live until the new one is approved"

Only an accepted account creates listings (PA-ACC-07): while the partner application is under review or was rejected, the editor is replaced by a short state 'Listings open after approval' with one action to the account status (HL-ACCS-04)
screens.contentNotes: Demo: Floral arrangements, «تنسيق ورد الأفراح», package «كوشة وورد الطاولات» per package, Standard KD 1,200, Voucher KD 1,000 (illustrative, fixtures request pending). Categories AR: «الضيافة والتموين» «خدمات البوفيه» «تنسيق الورد» «التنسيق والديكور» «تخطيط المناسبات والتنسيق». Names may not reuse the planner tier names (Silver, Gold, Royal).

screens.purpose: Choose the advertising or listing plan: Weekly, Monthly or Annual, with a short list of what each includes. Rates are not decided: while they are not set every card says "Rates announced soon" and the continue action is disabled with that reason. Major hotels see an explanation instead of plans and go straight to review.
interactions: Three single-choice plan cards (Weekly, Monthly, Annual) in the shared card style, each showing the cycle length and either the admin-configured price through the formatter or "Rates announced soon"; the Annual card never shows a made-up saving percentage
A note under the cards: "Your listing goes live only after Ghazal reviews and approves it. The plan period starts at approval."
Primary "Continue to payment" (opens HL-PROV-05) is disabled until a rate exists with the reason "Payment opens when rates are announced"; with rates set it needs a chosen plan
Fee-exempt variant: "Major hotel · no listing fees. Your listing still needs review." with the primary "Submit for review"
screens.contentNotes: No price number appears anywhere in this design: the prototype's "rates-set-sample" state shows a clearly labelled "Sample" amount from a fixture marked not-for-release. Copy AR: «الأسعار تُعلن قريبًا» / "Rates announced soon"; «تبدأ مدة الباقة عند الاعتماد» / "The plan period starts when your listing is approved." Owner decision: rates (OQ-V-07).

ownerRound1.change: Plans are for service providers; hotels and halls on contract see a contract card
ownerRound1.note: Plan chooser appears in plan mode only. Contract mode shows "Your terms are set in your Ghazal contract" with a support link. Rates are managed in Super Admin; "Rates announced soon" stays until set. Submissions are allowed before rates exist.

screens.purpose: Pay for the chosen plan through the gateway (same hosted methods as the client voucher) and see every outcome. Payment moves the listing to review; it never publishes it. Rates not set means the screen cannot be reached.
interactions: Summary: listing, plan and period, amount through the formatter (never a literal), and the line "Payment does not publish your listing; Ghazal reviews it first"; methods in platform order from the server as for CL-PAYM-01; the gateway frame and pending-bank state behave as CL-PAYM-02 and CL-PAYM-03

Success: "Payment received. Your listing is in review." with a receipt link and a primary "View review status" (HL-PROV-06); failure: "The payment could not be completed. No amount was charged." with retry and switch method
Refund note: "If your listing is rejected you get notes to fix and resubmit; a refund of the fee is handled by Support on request in full"
screens.contentNotes: Receipts are plan invoices (KWD on the document). Amounts in the prototype come from the sample fixture only. A SUCCESS arriving after a lapsed checkout still records the payment. Offline: "Offline. Reconnect to pay."

ownerRound1.change: Refund note: refunds on support request, no automatic 14-day rule
ownerRound1.note: Note: "If your listing is not approved you receive notes to fix and resubmit. A refund of the listing fee is handled by Support on request." AR: «إن لم يُعتمد إعلانكم تصلكم ملاحظات للتعديل وإعادة الإرسال. استرداد رسوم الإدراج يتم عبر الدعم عند الطلب.»

screens.purpose: Where a listing is in manual review: Pending (what to expect), Approved (when it goes live) or Rejected with reason codes and a note, and the way to edit and resubmit. Moderators check content compliance and correct category placement; exempt partners are reviewed too.
interactions: Timeline: Submitted, Payment received (absent for exempt partners), In review, Decision, Live; absolute timestamps; a long-wait line after 48 hours with "Contact Ghazal support"

Rejected: reason chips (Content not compliant, Wrong category, Missing details, Unclear pricing, Other) and the moderator's note in the provider's language; primary "Edit and resubmit" (HL-PROV-03); a note says a fee refund is handled by Support on request and is recorded in the platform
Approved: "Your listing goes live now; your plan runs until Fri 11 Dec 2026" and a link to performance; a push and an in-app notice arrive on every decision
screens.contentNotes: Reasons AR: «محتوى غير مطابق للشروط» «تصنيف غير صحيح» «بيانات ناقصة» «أسعار غير واضحة» «سبب آخر». Rejected copy: «لم نتمكن من اعتماد الإعلان. عدّلوا الملاحظات أدناه وأعيدوا الإرسال.» / "We could not approve your listing. Fix the notes below and resubmit." Status chip colours follow the functional set with icon plus label. Decision source: web Super Admin review queue (SA-REV).

ownerRound1.change: Rejected state shows notes and a refund-on-request path; the 14-day retention is removed
ownerRound1.note: Rejected: the team notes (reason codes plus a note) with "Edit and resubmit" and "Ask support for a refund". States rejected-plan-retained and rejected-refunded become rejected-with-notes and refund-requested. The refund is recorded in the platform.

screens.purpose: How a listing is doing: views, saves, vouchers purchased for it and requests, for a date range, with a table twin for every chart. The provider counterpart of venue analytics.
interactions: Range chips This month (default), Last 30 days, Last 90 days, Custom (the Sunday-first range calendar sheet); KPI tiles Views, Saves, Vouchers purchased, Requests, Redeemed with deltas
Funnel Views - Saves - Vouchers - Requests - Redeemed as horizontal bars from the inline-start edge, each with a "View as table" twin; top packages ranked list
Live listings only; an expired listing shows the last period and "Renew" (HL-PROV-04)
screens.contentNotes: Demo (illustrative): Views 640, Saves 58, Vouchers purchased 17, Requests 14, Redeemed 6. No revenue figures: the provider is paid by the client directly and Ghazal does not see it.
